gospel.title: Holy Gospel of Jesus Christ according to Saint Mark
gospel.text:
[[Mc 9,41]]Jesus said to his disciples: "Anyone who gives you a cup of water to drink because you belong to Christ, amen, I say to you, will surely not lose his reward.
[[Mc 9,42]]Whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in me to sin, it would be better for him if a great millstone were put around his neck and he were thrown into the sea.
[[Mc 9,43]]If your hand causes you to sin, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life maimed than with two hands to go into Gehenna, into the unquenchable fire.
[[Mc 9,44]]
[[Mc 9,45]]And if your foot causes you to sin, cut if off. It is better for you to enter into life crippled than with two feet to be thrown into Gehenna.
[[Mc 9,46]]
[[Mc 9,47]]And if your eye causes you to sin, pluck it out. Better for you to enter into the Kingdom of God with one eye than with two eyes to be thrown into Gehenna,
[[Mc 9,48]]where their worm does not die, and the fire is not quenched.
[[Mc 9,49]]Everyone will be salted with fire.
[[Mc 9,50]]Salt is good, but if salt becomes insipid, with what will you restore its flavor? Keep salt in yourselves and you will have peace with one another."

psalm.title: Psalms
psalm.text:
[[Ps 1,1]]Blessed the man who follows not 
the counsel of the wicked 
Nor walks in the way of sinners, 
nor sits in the company of the insolent,
[[Ps 1,2]]But delights in the law of the LORD 
and meditates on his law day and night.

[[Ps 1,3]]He is like a tree 
planted near running water, 
that yields its fruit in due season, 
and whose leaves never fade. 
Whatever he does, prospers.

[[Ps 1,4]]Not so, the wicked, not so; 
they are like chaff which the wind drives away.
[[Ps 1,6]]For the LORD watches over the way of the just,
but the way of the wicked vanishes.

first_reading.title: Book of Sirach
first_reading.text:
[[Si 5,1]]Rely not on your wealth; say not: "I have the power."
[[Si 5,2]]Rely not on your strength in following the desires of your heart.
[[Si 5,3]]Say not: "Who can prevail against me?" for the LORD will exact the punishment.
[[Si 5,4]]Say not: "I have sinned, yet what has befallen me?" for the LORD bides his time.
[[Si 5,5]]Of forgiveness be not overconfident, adding sin upon sin.
[[Si 5,6]]Say not: "Great is his mercy; my many sins he will forgive."
[[Si 5,7]]For mercy and anger alike are with him; upon the wicked alights his wrath.
[[Si 5,8]]Delay not your conversion to the LORD, put it not off from day to day;
[[Si 5,9]]For suddenly his wrath flames forth; at the time of vengeance, you will be destroyed.
[[Si 5,10]]Rely not upon deceitful wealth, for it will be no help on the day of wrath.
